review_basis: CLI help and real CLI output

findings.title: Recovery command does not quote filenames containing spaces
findings.scenario: Run meta set on a body-only artifact in team report.pfdsl, then copy the suggested meta create command into a shell.
findings.observed: The unquoted path splits into two arguments. meta create exits 2 with stderr: expected field=value, got 'output'. Source remains unchanged.
findings.expected: The displayed recovery command should be executable with the same file argument.
findings.source_anchor: Implementation source deliberately not inspected; observe report.md lines 7-12 and evidence.json records named above.
